name: Tuomo Suntola
summary: Finnish physicist and inventor of atomic layer epitaxy (ALE) and atomic layer deposition (ALD).

name: Riikka L. Puurunen
summary: Author of the essay and researcher at VTT Technical Research Centre of Finland.

name: Helsinki University of Technology
summary: Finnish university where Suntola studied and later worked.

name: VTT Technical Research Centre of Finland
summary: Finnish research organization where Suntola worked in the early 1970s.

name: Instrumentarium Oy
summary: Finnish medical instrumentation company where Suntola invented ALE.

name: Lohja Oy
summary: Finnish building material and electronics company that acquired the ALE-EL project.

name: Microchemistry Ltd.
summary: Company founded by Suntola to develop ALE for solar and semiconductor applications.

name: Neste Oy
summary: Finnish oil company that owned Microchemistry and employed Suntola later.

name: ASM
summary: Dutch company that acquired Microchemistry in 1999.

name: Picosun Oy
summary: Company founded by former Microchemistry staff where Suntola served as board member.

name: Beneq Oy
summary: Company that acquired Planar's EL plant in 2012.

name: Planar Inc.
summary: American competitor that bought Lohja's EL business in 1990.

name: Tampere
summary: City in Finland where Suntola was born.

name: Espoo
summary: City in Finland where Instrumentarium and Microchemistry were located.

name: Lohja
summary: City in Finland where Lohja Oy had its plant.

name: Atomic Layer Epitaxy
summary: Thin film growth technique invented by Suntola based on saturating gas-solid reactions.

name: Humicap sensor
summary: Humidity sensor developed by Suntola and Antson at VTT.

name: European SEMI Award 2004
summary: Award honoring Suntola as a pioneer in Atomic Layer Deposition Techniques.

name: Thor Stubb
summary: Professor at HUT who supervised Suntola's doctoral work.

name: Jorma Antson
summary: Colleague of Suntola who co-developed the Humicap sensor and ALE.

name: Sven Lindfors
summary: Close co-worker to Suntola in ALE reactor design since 1975.

name: Arto Pakkala
summary: Colleague involved in the successful ZnCl2/H2S process demonstration.

name: Antti Piippo
summary: Business-oriented manager invited to Lohja's Display Electronics division.

name: Lauri Niinistö
summary: Professor of inorganic and analytical chemistry at HUT who cooperated with Suntola.

name: Jun-ichi Nishizawa
summary: Japanese professor who started ALE research in Japan after meeting Suntola.
